provider_independent_retention_taxonomy.purpose: Establishes clear boundaries for research artifact retention independent of specific vendor terms, recognizing that derived products (weights, returns, statistics) may still be subject to contractual derivation covenants.

CLASS_1_VENDOR_RAW_OBSERVATIONS.description: Raw unadjusted/adjusted price quotes, trade prints, bid/ask ticks obtained from third-party vendor APIs.
CLASS_1_VENDOR_RAW_OBSERVATIONS.retention_rules: Almost universally subject to mandatory purge clauses upon subscription termination. Must NOT be committed into public or permanent VCS repositories without explicit redistribution licenses.

CLASS_2_VENDOR_DERIVED_VALUES.description: Quantitative features, technical indicators, rolling volatilities, and daily returns computed directly from vendor prices.
CLASS_2_VENDOR_DERIVED_VALUES.retention_rules: Many vendor agreements (e.g. Tiingo Starter, Massive Developer) treat mathematical transformations as Derived Products. Retention requires verification of non-display/derived works covenants.

CLASS_3_INDEPENDENT_OPERATIONAL_EVENTS.description: Locally generated execution timestamps, regime state transitions, and simulator state changes.
CLASS_3_INDEPENDENT_OPERATIONAL_EVENTS.retention_rules: Proprietary internal event logs generated by Guardian Alpha architecture; free from third-party IP claims.

CLASS_4_RESEARCH_REPORTS.description: Analytical markdown documents, governance audits, and audit narratives.
CLASS_4_RESEARCH_REPORTS.retention_rules: Original copyright of repository owner. Permitted for permanent archival.

CLASS_5_AUDIT_LOGS_AND_JOURNALS.description: Cryptographic checksum manifests, command execution ledgers, and unit test run logs.
CLASS_5_AUDIT_LOGS_AND_JOURNALS.retention_rules: Required for scientific reproducibility and regulatory audit trails.

CLASS_6_STRATEGY_SOURCE_CODE.description: Python implementation files for strategies and simulators.
CLASS_6_STRATEGY_SOURCE_CODE.retention_rules: Proprietary trading strategy code; free from third-party data restrictions.

CLASS_7_SYNTHETIC_SIMULATION_OUTPUTS.description: Monte Carlo power matrices, bootstrap distribution statistics, and synthetic AR(1) fixtures.
CLASS_7_SYNTHETIC_SIMULATION_OUTPUTS.retention_rules: Generated purely from mathematical random number generators without referencing any vendor market data.
